chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
All things in the whole expanse of being, in higher and lower degrees, are set in one order after the form of the Divine Human; and the formed outer person is an effect of that same order brought down into use.

The first receptacle of life in a person is as an initial gathering of fundamental truths prepared for manifestation. From the first descent of life into what begins to govern thought and intention down to the inmost center where love rules, there is the likeness of the whole arranged series of interior degrees. The ruling love itself is the central turning by which all subordinate things are held together and kept in ordered motion. From that ruling center down to the lower powers that receive, sort, and separate, there is the likeness of the intermediate region that mediates between inward and outward, extending from higher understanding into the lowest life. The active outmost power is the ultimate plane where determination passes into effect. From the lower powers of reception down to the strength of natural life there is the likeness of the complete outmost planes in their threefold arrangement. The hardened supports of action are the ultimate station where what is lowest is held fast under a guarding authority. The final sensibility that touches the world is the lowest plane itself, together with the fixed restraints that prevent it from breaking order. Ardent desire is the containing form of love; obscured corporeal sensation is the containing form of falsity that extinguishes light; and the circulating natural life is the containing form of truth in the understanding, living or perverted according to the ruling love.

In this way the lesser form is an image of the greater in its interior degrees, in its ordered arrangements, in its elevations and descents of state, in its boundaries, and in its containing forms.

There are five general administrations in the outermost region of ordered life, and a sufficient complement of operative powers preside over them.

In the first and highest administration, governed by the preserving of brightness in understanding, there is authority over the three discrete interior degrees; and beneath it stand subordinate powers in service under the governance of the upholding of the dignity of good.

In the second administration, governed by the upholding of the dignity of good, there is authority over the complete series of the arrangements beneath.

In the third administration, governed by the power that gives firmness and resistance against evil, authority extends from the intermediate region down into the lowest plane; and according to its office it strengthens the general ordering of thought that turns through knowledges, and the breadth of intermediate life, together with a complete set of outward arrangements appointed within the natural degree.

In the fourth administration, governed by the guarding of acknowledgment of what is Divine, there is authority over the three general turnings of life’s operations, and over the three outmost planes borne upon the ultimate guarding power.

In the fifth administration, governed by the ultimate guarding power, there is authority over the lowest plane on which it is fixed, and over the fixed restraints by which that plane is held together.

Yet disorder has entered these administrations at times.

In the administration of preserved brightness, evil pressed upward against a formed receptacle of higher message; it was barred from entrance into that degree and fell back, stripped of confidence.

In the administration of upheld good, a shaking of foundations and betrayal arose; but the powers that stood up in that moment, and the powers sent to restrain, were brought down until they were reduced into submission.

In the administration of firmness against evil, aborted beginnings of life descended into the lowest plane and fashioned an external humanity without inward order.

In the administration of guarded acknowledgment, a tumult arose in the outmost planes above the ultimate guard, and the way of elevation was obstructed for the three general operations by which life ought to rise—those of persuasion, of understanding, and of love.

In the administration of the ultimate guard, the fixed restraints beneath were uncovered and the bindings of order were strained, and a great overthrow came upon the ultimate plane.

Further, the instruction of wisdom that circulates through a person is the image of pure receptivity of truth from the Divine, which in ordered alternation descends into lower degrees and ascends again through all degrees.

Likewise, love and delight, faith and truth, in which a person ought to live, are the two general means of elevation and liberation; by them the living mind is raised and set free, lifted from the lowest obscurities into the highest states.

There are four general regions of life in the outer person, and within the life of these four regions there are endlessly repeated complete sets of governing principles.

The first region is the highest natural plane, and its governors are the receptive faculties for perception and discernment in their paired forms, together with the faculty that admits and judges what is taken in for appropriation.

The second region is the plane of outward power for interaction, and its governors are the paired powers of operation answering to the paired powers of perception, the paired affections of nourishment and support answering to the paired discriminations, the two interior regards of the ruling love, and the faculty of admission and passage between them that answers to appropriation.

The third region has again a complete set of governors: the general provision for preservation, the power that breathes life into understanding, the power of discrimination and separation, the ardent desire that warms and excites action, the bitter reaction against evil, and the paired power of purification and balance.

The fourth region, the lowest, has likewise a complete set of the same kind: the paired supports for standing in the world, the paired potencies for producing effects, the paired strengths of conjunction, and the active power from which interior truth goes forth in potency to generate forms of life.

There is also a full organization of truths in the higher natural understanding, bound together in one turning order and fixed in their places, so that the whole may be led as one, and the beginning and the end may be grasped together within the same system.

This same full organization exists in a person successively from highest to lowest, so that each degree and function is under its leading truth, down to the outmost sensibility; and it exists simultaneously as well, distributed in mutual relation on both sides, set each opposite its companion and joined as beginning with end in a single form, according to the ordering of the maker of the human form.

Finally, there are innumerable lesser powers within a person, like inhabitants set as leaders within their own provinces. They are fixed in their quarters according to function, and the provinces of their functions exceed numbering. When these lesser powers move and operate, they meet; and if disorder rules, they oppose and ruin one another within their own domain. As outward life comes to its end, such disordered forces break out from the organized form and appear as grievous states in the natural degree—now as inward sickness, now as outward corruption. These states first open and cast out what has been stored up in falsity and evil until impurity is expelled from the affected place; afterward the outward breach is closed, and there is a temporary relief in externals from what had erupted, while the inner cause is healed only by reordering life from within.

paragraph_translations.translation: All things in the whole expanse of being, in higher and lower degrees, are arranged after one living form; and the outer person is formed according to that same order brought down into use.
paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the teaching by stating the universal order and its image in the human form.

paragraph_translations.translation: The inmost beginning in a person is an initial gathering of fundamental truths prepared to clothe higher things for manifestation. From that first beginning down to the center where love rules, there is the likeness of the whole series of interior degrees; and that ruling love is the central turning that holds all subordinate things in connection and motion. From that center down through the lower powers of receiving, sorting, and separating, there is the likeness of the intermediate region that mediates between inward and outward, extending from higher understanding into the lowest life. The active outmost power is the ultimate plane where determination becomes effect. From the lower receptive powers down to the strength of natural life there is the likeness of the complete outmost planes in their threefold arrangement. The hardened supports of action are the ultimate station where what is lowest is held under a guarding authority; and the final sensibility that touches the world is the lowest plane itself together with the fixed restraints that keep it from breaking order. Ardent desire is the containing form of love; obscured corporeal sensation is the containing form of falsity that extinguishes light; and the circulating natural life is the containing form of truth in the understanding, living or perverted according to the ruling love.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the universal statement by mapping the series of degrees and containing forms within a person.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source’s anatomical mapping is uneven (two places marked with uncertainty), but the spiritual series remains coherent; the specific assignment of “male part” is rendered as active outmost power.

paragraph_translations.translation: In this way the lesser form is an image of the greater in its interior degrees, in its ordered arrangements, in its elevations and descents of state, in its boundaries, and in its containing forms.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES as a summation of the preceding mapping.

paragraph_translations.translation: Further, there are five general administrations in the outermost region of ordered life, and a sufficient complement of operative powers preside over them.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from the body-as-image to a fivefold governance structure.
paragraph_translations.notes: Named figures are translated by function rather than retained as names.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the first and highest administration, governed by the preserving of brightness in understanding, there is authority over the three discrete interior degrees; and beneath it stand subordinate powers in service under the governance of the upholding of the dignity of good.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by detailing the first administration and its subordination.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the second administration, governed by the upholding of the dignity of good, there is authority over the complete series of the arrangements beneath.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the enumeration of administrations.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the third administration, governed by the power that gives firmness and resistance against evil, authority extends from the intermediate region down into the lowest plane; and according to its office it strengthens the general ordering of thought that turns through knowledges, and the breadth of intermediate life, together with a complete set of outward arrangements appointed within the natural degree.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the third administration’s scope and strengthening action.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the fourth administration, governed by the guarding of acknowledgment of what is Divine, there is authority over the three general turnings of life’s operations, and over the three outmost planes borne upon the ultimate guarding power.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the enumeration and narrows to threefold operations and ultimates.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the fifth administration, governed by the ultimate guarding power, there is authority over the lowest plane on which it is fixed, and over the fixed restraints by which that plane is held together.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES and completes the fivefold governance list.

paragraph_translations.translation: Yet disorder has entered these five administrations at times.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from structure to episodes of disturbance.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the administration of preserved brightness, evil pressed upward against a formed receptacle of higher message; it was barred from entrance into that degree and fell back, stripped of confidence.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS with the first instance of disorder and restraint.
paragraph_translations.notes: The “image of the Ambassador” is rendered as a formed receptacle of higher influx; the exact identity of “Ambassador” resists more specific translation.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the administration of upheld good, a shaking of foundations and betrayal arose; but the powers that then stood up in that disturbance, and the powers sent to restrain, were brought down until they were reduced into submission.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the disorder narrative with a second disturbance and its humbling.
paragraph_translations.notes: Agency in the source is syntactically tangled; the translation keeps the outcome: disturbance restrained and reduced.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the administration of firmness against evil, aborted beginnings of life descended into the lowest plane and fashioned an external humanity without inward order.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES with a third disturbance affecting the outmost formation.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the administration of guarded acknowledgment, a tumult arose in the outmost planes above the ultimate guard, and the way of elevation was obstructed for the three general operations by which life ought to rise—those of persuasion, of understanding, and of love.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES with a fourth disturbance that blocks ascent.
paragraph_translations.notes: The triad “wind, water, fire” is translated as persuasion, understanding, and love; sequence is inferred from the table and context.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the administration of the ultimate guard, the fixed restraints beneath were uncovered and the bindings of order were strained, and a great overthrow came upon the ultimate plane.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES with the fifth and lowest disturbance.

paragraph_translations.translation: Moreover, the instruction of wisdom that circulates through a person is the image of pure receptivity of truth from the Divine, which in ordered alternation descends into lower degrees and ascends again through all degrees.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from disturbances to orderly circulation of wisdom.
paragraph_translations.notes: The named feminine figure is translated by function as pure receptivity of truth.

paragraph_translations.translation: Likewise, love and delight, faith and truth, in which a person ought to live, are the two general means of elevation and liberation; by them the living mind is raised and set free, lifted from the lowest obscurities into the highest states.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by stating the paired means of ascent and freedom.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source’s two conveyances are rendered as two general means; their specific pairing is kept as love/delight and faith/truth.

paragraph_translations.translation: Further, understand this also: there are four general regions of life in the outer person, and within the life of these four regions there are endlessly repeated complete sets of governing principles.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to a fourfold division and its repeated governance.
paragraph_translations.notes: The hyperbolic numeric expression is carried as “endlessly repeated complete sets.”

paragraph_translations.translation: The first region is the highest natural plane, and its complete set of governors are the receptive faculties for perception and discernment in their paired forms, together with the faculty that admits and judges what is taken in for appropriation.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by detailing the first region’s governors.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second region is the plane of outward power for interaction, and its governors are the paired powers of operation answering to the paired powers of perception, the paired affections of nourishment and support answering to the paired discriminations, the two interior regards of the ruling love, and the faculty of admission and passage between them that answers to appropriation.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES with the second region and its full set of powers.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Two eyes of the heart” is rendered as two interior regards of the ruling love.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the third region there is again a complete set of governors: the general provision for preservation, the power that breathes life into understanding, the power of discrimination and separation, the ardent desire that warms and excites action, the bitter reaction against evil, and the paired power of purification and balance.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES with the third region’s interior functions.
paragraph_translations.notes: Some items are physiologically obscure in the source-list, but their functional spiritual rendering is stable.

paragraph_translations.translation: In the fourth region, the lowest, there is again a complete set of the same kind: the paired supports for standing in the world, the paired potencies for producing effects, the paired strengths of conjunction, and the active power from which interior truth goes forth in potency to generate forms of life.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES and completes the fourfold regional scheme.
paragraph_translations.notes: The generative item is rendered as truth in potency generating forms; the exact natural specificity is left behind as required.

paragraph_translations.translation: There is a full organization of truths in the higher natural understanding, arranged as a complete pattern, bound together in one turning order, fixed in their places as if planted, so that the whole may be led as one and the beginning and the end may be grasped together within the same system.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from regions to a complete organized system of leading truths.
paragraph_translations.notes: The zodiacal nomenclature is not retained; it is translated into the notion of a full organized pattern of truths.

paragraph_translations.translation: This same full organization exists in a person in successive order from what is highest to what is lowest, so that each degree and function is under its distinct leading truth, from the first reception of life down to the outmost sensibility.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by applying the organized pattern successively through the person.
paragraph_translations.notes: The detailed sign-to-body mapping becomes degree/function-to-leading-truth mapping in spiritual terms.

paragraph_translations.translation: This organization also exists in simultaneous form, so that the ordered truths stand in mutual relation as if bent into one shape, each set opposite its companion, joined as beginning with end within a single rising order of life.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by shifting from successive to simultaneous arrangement.
paragraph_translations.notes: The “turned to the side and bent” phrasing is rendered as simultaneous form and mutual opposition within one form.

paragraph_translations.translation: Thus the pattern is counted in the order of the whole form and all its functions, distributed on both sides so that one complete half is on one side and another complete half on the other, spread out for mutual relation.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by explaining bilateral completeness in simultaneity.
paragraph_translations.notes: The numeric “six and six” is preserved as the idea of two complete halves.

paragraph_translations.translation: On one side of this simultaneous form, the leading truths descend in order from the inmost perceptive beginning through the operative powers and supports of natural life down to the generative boundary of outward action.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing one side’s descending series in functional terms.
paragraph_translations.notes: The specific anatomical stations resist direct spiritual naming without leaving natural objects; the translation therefore renders them as a descending functional series.

paragraph_translations.translation: On the other side, the companion leading truths ascend in reciprocal order from the generative boundary back toward the inmost perceptive beginning, set opposite their companions and joined as end with beginning in one ordered unity according to the maker of the human form.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES and completes the bilateral, reciprocal arrangement.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source’s left-side list is reversed; translation keeps the reciprocal ascent and mutual opposition.

paragraph_translations.translation: Attend to this further teaching: there are innumerable lesser powers within a person, like inhabitants made leaders within their own provinces. They are fixed in their quarters according to function, and the provinces of their functions exceed numbering.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS from the patterned system to the multitude of subordinate powers.
paragraph_translations.notes: Large numbers are rendered as innumerable and beyond counting while preserving the sense of ordered quartering.

paragraph_translations.translation: When these lesser powers move and operate within a person’s life, they meet; and if disorder rules, they oppose and ruin one another within their own domain. As outward life comes to its end, such disordered forces break out from the organized form and appear as grievous states in the natural degree—now as inward sickness, now as outward corruption. These states first open and cast out what has been stored up in falsity and evil until impurity is expelled from the affected place; afterward the outward breach is closed, and there is a temporary relief in externals from what had erupted, though the inner cause is healed only by reordering life from within.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by showing the consequences of disorder and the process of purgation and closure.
paragraph_translations.notes: The source’s detailed medical imagery is translated as the expulsion of stored falsity/evil and temporary external relief.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coheres strongly as one teaching: the human form as an image of universal order; five administrations governing degrees; episodes of disorder; then circulation of wisdom and paired means of liberation; then four regions with repeated governors; then a complete organized pattern of leading truths in successive and simultaneous order; finally innumerable subordinate powers and how disorder manifests and is purged. The only strain points are (1) a few uncertain anatomical terms and (2) named figures like the “Ambassador,” whose function is implied but not fully specified in this excerpt.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential opening: macrocosm–microcosm thesis stated without governance inventory or rank-listing.
findings.evidence: Text: “This whole universe, above and below, reflects the pattern of the human body; as the formation of this body of flesh accords to the pattern of the universe.” The spiritual reading reports it “OPENS the teaching by stating the universal order and its image in the human form,” and does not have to force named jurisdictions or offices. This is the substrate’s functional image-teaching.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential anatomy-by-function mapping; difficulties are genuine (minor textual/lexical uncertainty), not insertion.
findings.evidence: Text maps parts by what they are/contain/do: “Its liver to the vessel of fire. Its flesh to the vessel of darkness. Its blood to the vessel of water.” This is classic function-based correspondence (vessels/containment). The spiritual reading notes only “anatomical mapping is uneven (two places marked with uncertainty)”—matching the manuscript’s “intestines (?)” and the bracketed “[male]” but still finding a coherent functional series. ¶4 is a summative glue: “Now, this is how the small body corresponds to the macro-cosmos…”. Removing anything here would not improve flow; it would destroy the chapter’s base analogy.

findings.diagnosis: Insertion of an administrative governance dossier into a correspondential body–cosmos mapping; narrative voice switches from functional likeness to jurisdictional chain-of-command with named masters and watch-stations. The spiritual reading ‘rescues’ coherence only by translating names into functions, which is a sign the passage itself is not teaching by function but by administration.
findings.evidence: The seam is explicit at ¶5: “Once more, I reveal to you: There exist five great camps… of which the five sons of the Living Spirit are masters.” Then the content is territorial/jurisdictional: “watch-station… master… authority over the three heavens… seven firmaments… authority reigns from the firmament down… master… four fastenings under his feet” (¶6-10). This is governance language (master/authority/reigns/appointed). The subsequent ‘episodes’ (¶11-16) remain framed as disturbances ‘in the watch of X,’ not as organic states within the body: “Affliction has come about in these five watches… in the watch of the Keeper of Splendour… in the watch of the great King of Honour…” etc. The spiritual reading itself flags the underlying problem indirectly: it marks a “SHIFTS… to a fivefold governance structure” and repeatedly notes that “Named figures are translated by function rather than retained as names,” and that the triad “wind, water, fire” requires inferred spiritual substitutions. Those are classic symptoms of an overlay that does not organically yield correspondential sense from natural function; instead it requires allegorical re-tooling to fit the chapter’s earlier mode.
findings.scope:
Excise ¶5–¶16 in full:
“Once more, I reveal to you: There exist five great camps in this great outer zone, of which the five sons of the Living Spirit are masters.

So, in the first watch-station above, of which the Keeper of Splendour is master, on the battlement of all the works, is found his authority over the three heavens. Then the ones below him [are under his command, and they serve] the great King of Honour.

The second watch, of which the great King of Honour is master, his own authority (extends) over the seven firmaments beneath him.

The third watch, of which the Adamant [is master, his authority] reigns from the firmament down below to the [earth]. [And he] invigorates, according to his authority, the sphere and the worlds of the atmosphere; and the other four worlds that are appointed on this earth.

⟨p.171⟩
The fourth watch, over which the King of Glory has power, is the three wheels. And his authority lies over the three earths upon the head of the Porter.

The fifth watch is the watch over which the Porter is authoritative. Again, he is master, according to his authority, over this great earth he stands upon, and the four fastenings under his feet.

Affliction has come about in these five watches from time to time.

So, in the watch of the Keeper of Splendour, sin desired to spurt up towards the image of the Ambassador. Yet, they barred it from that place, and it fell back down in shame.

Again, an earthquake and treachery occurred in the watch of the great King of Honour, which the watchers who had arisen at the time and had [stood firm, and restrained] they who were sent came down, until they were humbled.

Also, in the watch of the Adamant, the abortions came to the earth and fashioned [the] figure of flesh.

Again, in the watch of the King of Glory, a commotion happened in these three earths above the Porter. The pathway was obstructed for the ascent of these three wheels; that of wind, that of water, and that of fire.

Also, in the watch of the Porter, the fastenings beneath were laid bare and strained their chains. A great earthquake befell that place.”

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential resumption after the administrative block: returns to ‘circulates in that body’ and paired inner states as vehicles, i.e., functional teaching rather than jurisdictions.
findings.evidence: Text returns to organic operation: “the teaching of wisdom, which circulates in that body” (¶23) and then inner-state pairs “love and joy, faith and truth… the living soul should go up in them” (¶24). The spiritual reading experiences this as a natural “SHIFTS from disturbances to orderly circulation of wisdom,” which is exactly what happens if ¶5–16 are an overlay: ¶2–4 body–cosmos likeness → (overlay) five watches → back to body’s circulation/means of ascent.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential but with a mild mixed didactic: ‘worlds’ and ‘rulers’ language could be read administratively; however the rulers are immediately given as bodily faculties/organs, so the spiritual sense still arises from function and structure rather than named jurisdictions.
findings.evidence: Text: “There exist four worlds in this body… countless times seven rulers…” (¶25) then lists sense-organs and internal organs as ‘rulers’ (¶26-29). Unlike ¶5-16, there are no named cosmic officials or watch-stations; the ‘rulers’ are anatomical governors (eyes/ears/mouth/arms/breasts/kidneys etc.), which the spiritual reading can translate functionally without inventing a bureaucracy. The only strain noted is that some items are “physiologically obscure,” which is consistent with lexical uncertainty, not insertion.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from imported astral nomenclature, but not an administrative overlay: it is still correspondential mapping (zodiac ↔ body), organized by order/number and by successive/simultaneous arrangement. The reader’s ‘stumble’ is handled by paraphrasing away the zodiac names, indicating the passage is culturally distant rather than textually intrusive.
findings.evidence: Text is mapping-by-placement and ordered series: “these are the twelve signs… appointed… leaders… on the sphere” (¶31) and then “Its head is Aries… soles… Pisces” (¶32), then bilateral distribution “six… right… six… left… head to tail” (¶34-36). While “leaders” could look administrative, the content is not a chain of command; it is a fixed correspondential schema (body-part correspondences, successive/simultaneous ordering). The spiritual reading’s strategy—“zodiacal nomenclature is not retained”—shows interpretive accommodation, not a narrative break where the chapter’s story cannot proceed. Removing ¶31-36 would amputate a major correspondential unit (12-fold order) that matches the chapter’s macrocosm–microcosm program.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential/physiological moralization: ‘powers’ are described by behavior (creeping, meeting, destroying, erupting) and bodily consequence (sores, discharge, healing), not by jurisdiction. Strong substrate feel.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by dynamics: “rulers… distributed… quartered according to house” (¶38) then concrete process: “come creeping and moving… beset and destroy… erupt… boils and sores… discharge… scars… healed” (¶39). The spiritual reading finds a coherent process narrative of disorder and purgation and does not report a voice-break; the sense arises from what these ‘powers’ do (conflict/eruption/purging), i.e., correspondential function.

textual_criticism.summary: 7 findings total: 5 clean correspondential confirmations (¶2; ¶3-4; ¶23-24; ¶31-36; ¶38-39), 1 mixed-but-coherent section (¶25-29), and 1 major disruption (¶5-16) diagnosed as an administrative insertion into a functional body–cosmos teaching. Recommendations: excise 1 block (¶5-16), annotate 0, none 6.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: This whole universe, above and below, reflects the pattern of the human body; as the formation of this body of flesh accords to the pattern of the universe.

Its head is like the first-fruits of the five garments. And, from its neck down to the site of its heart, it resembles the pattern of the ten firmaments. And again, the heart accords to the wheel of the rotating sphere. And, from its heart down to its intestines (?), is like this atmosphere that extends from the sphere down to the earth. The [male] part of the body corresponds to this great earth. And also, from its intestines (?) down to its loins is like the three earths. And also, its shinbones to the pattern of the space in which the Porter stands. Its footsoles to the great earth upon which the Porter is stood; and the four fastenings that are under his feet. Its liver to the vessel of fire. Its flesh to the vessel of darkness. Its blood to the vessel of water.
Now, this is how the small body corresponds to the macro-cosmos in its firmaments, in its orderings, in its mountains, its walls and its vessels, as I have made clear to you!
Also, the teaching of wisdom, which circulates in that body: to the likeness of the Virgin of Light, who goes up and comes down in this zone, above and below.

Also, love and joy, faith and truth, in which the person should live: they are to the likeness of these two light ships. For, the living soul should go up in them and become free through them; and it ascends from the abysses below and arrives at the heights above.
Once more, understand this other (truth): There exist four worlds in this body of the flesh, and there exist countless times seven rulers in the body of the four worlds!

So, the first world is from its neck up; and also the seven rulers who are in this upper world are these: the two organs of sight, and the two of hearing, and the two of smell. The other one is the mouth, which is the organ of taste.

The second world is from its neck down to its entire upper torso. And also, the seven rulers who are in this second world are: its two arms that accord to the pattern of its two ears, which occur in its first world above; and its two breasts that are to the pattern of its organs of smell; and the two eyes of its heart; and the gullet of the stomach between the two breasts, which in the chest is the pattern of the mouth.

⟨p.173⟩
Once more, there exist seven rulers in the third world of the body, which are these: the fat, the lung, the spleen, the liver, the gall, and its two kidneys.

Also, the fourth world below. There are another seven there of this same kind: its two buttocks (?), and its two testicles, and its two loins; and the member out of which the seed comes, that begets all the forms.

Aries and Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces; these are the twelve signs of the zodiac that occur in the worlds above, on the sphere. They are interlocked and bound on this turning wheel, the one in which they are [set], fixed, and planted. And, regarding all these twelve signs of the zodiac, this is how they were appointed and made leaders [set] on the sphere beneath the heaven that is the wheel of the stars. Now, they are appointed like this, they are thus, so that you can find the head of [upon the twelve stations] and you find the tail too [each sign, and its companion]

Again, they occur like this, these that we have recited, one after another in this body. They are counted by order and number from the head to the feet. Its head is Aries. Its neck and its shoulders are Taurus. Its two arms Gemini. Its upper torso is Cancer. Its stomach is Leo. Its belly is Virgo. The vertical spine and its intestines (?) are Libra. Its genitals Scorpio. Its loins are Sagittarius. Its knees are Capricorn. Its shinbones are Aquarius. The soles of its feet are Pisces.

Behold, these are also distributed one after another. They exist in this body, as if turned to the side and bent to the pattern of the twelve signs of the zodiac. They too are thus, arranged one against another, head to tail, as they occur on the wheel [as it rises] up.

Also, they are counted by order and number of the body and all its members. So, we have proclaimed that these are turned to the side, bent, and spread out; because from its head down to its hip shall count six to its left, and another six to its right.

⟨p.174⟩
The six that are down its right are these that I will recount: the right temple is Aries; its right shoulder is Taurus; its right arm is Gemini; its right rib-cage is Cancer; its stomach is Leo; the right side of its reproductive organs are Virgo.

Conversely, the other six about which we have spoken, which are to its left, in contrast they come from its hip to its head: its left [hip] is Libra; its left rib-cage is Scorpio; its left breast and left kidney is Sagittarius; its [left] elbow is Capricorn; its left shoulder is Aquarius; its left temple is Pisces. This is how the creator of the body himself has appointed them. He has [set] them in order and arranged them, one against its companion, head to tail.

Listen to this other lesson that I will proclaim to you. Understand that there exist many powers in this body. They are the house-dwellers who are made the leaders in it. There are eight hundred and forty times ten thousand rulers made chiefs in the human body! They are distributed and set firm, quartered according to house. The count and number of their houses is two hundred and ten times ten thousand.

When all these rulers come creeping and moving within the body, they will meet one another; and they shall beset and destroy one another, and [work destruction] in them there. When [when the time is fulfilled]] they shall erupt from the body of the person who [will] die; and make putrid boils and sores and burning wounds in the body. Either they might have made him sick within; or else they might come forth upon his outer side. Those wounds shall first be squeezed and discharge their liquid, and empty out their pus, until they are squeezed [again, and again] and the suppuration forced out from the wound. Afterwards, their scars shall close over; and they are healed and obtain relief from the places that came out upon them.
